rule.description: 在解析层名称获取层索引时，应使用项目已有的 `extract_layer_index` 工具函数，而不是手动编写解析逻辑。同时，判断逻辑应尽量简化，使用公开 API 而非内部实现。

antipattern.code:
class AscendConfig:
    """Configuration for Ascend-specific features."""

    def _init_sparse_c8_config(self, additional_config: dict) -> None:
        """Initialize sparse C8 quantization configuration."""
        self.enable_sparse_c8 = additional_config.get(
            "enable_sparse_c8", False)
        if self.enable_sparse_c8:
            sparse_c8_layers = additional_config.get(
                "sparse_c8_layers", [])
            self.sparse_c8_layer_indices = set()
            for layer_name in sparse_c8_layers:
                # Manual parsing of layer index from layer name
                layer_index = int(layer_name.split(".")[-1])
                self.sparse_c8_layer_indices.add(layer_index)

    def is_sparse_c8_layer(self, layer_name: str) -> bool:
        """Check if a layer uses sparse C8 quantization."""
        layer_index = int(layer_name.split(".")[-1])
        return layer_index in self.sparse_c8_layer_indices

        self.enable_sparse_c8 = additional_config.get(
            "enable_sparse_c8", False)

            sparse_c8_layers = additional_config.get(
                "sparse_c8_layers", [])

    def is_sparse_c8_layer(self, layer_name: str) -> bool:
        """Check if a layer uses sparse C8 quantization."""
        layer_index = extract_layer_index(layer_name)
        return layer_index in self.sparse_c8_layer_indices
